# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, Slim), $54.99**
- It's 0.34" thick, 4.3 oz, and charges wirelessly at 15W with Qi2. Anker markets it for the iPhone 17 series.
- 9to5Mac called it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery, and said it runs cooler than the competition.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- At 5,000mAh it will give you roughly a 60-75% recharge, according to Macworld.

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K), about $53-70**
- Android Central's tester called it the thinnest and lightest of the bunch, at 0.27" and 104g.
- Its wireless speed is only 7.5W, so it's slower than the Anker.
- Amazon was listing it at $52.99 and $69.99 in that article. I don't have a direct product link, so see the [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) for the buy links.

**Best slim 10,000mAh with the fastest charging: INIU SnapGo Air (10K, 25W Qi2.2), about $43-49**
- It's 0.5" thick and 195g, and charges the iPhone 17 wirelessly at 25W, which needs an iPhone 16 or later.
- It also does 45W wired charging and includes a lanyard-style 60W cable.
- Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K pack, and Android Central praises its value.
- It was listed at $42.99 on Amazon and $44.99 on INIU's own store. I don't have a direct product link, so use the [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) for the buy buttons.

**Other options**
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K, 15W):** It's 0.57" thick and IP54 dust and water resistant, at $69.99-79.99 ([review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, 25W Qi2.2, 45W wired):** It's $59.99 at Baseus, or $53.99 with code AM52 ([Dealectric, affiliate link](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)). The source doesn't list its thickness, so it may not be as slim as the others.

**How to choose**
- **Pocketable for emergencies:** The Anker Nano 5K is the best balance of slimness and 15W Qi2 speed.
- **Most charge in a slim body:** The INIU SnapGo Air gives you about two charges and 25W wireless.
- **Not the iPhone 17 Pro:** If you need a larger 10K bank with extras like a kickstand, 9to5Mac and Macworld cover bulkier models, but they aren't slim.

Prices are from the listed sources and may have changed. Thick or non-magnetic cases can weaken the connection, so use a MagSafe-compatible case.

Sources: [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html), [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)
